name: 43215 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43215 (Columbus) has 741 nonprofit organizations. 380 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 350 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43215 (Columbus) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
59% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43215 (Columbus) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 8.1 times the typical level).
